summary: Account is brand new (10 IG followers). Weakest area: 77% reel drop-off in first 3 seconds and near-zero engagement across platforms — hooks aren't stopping the scroll. Bio violates brand rules (niche, region, timeframe, unauthorized free offer).
guidance:
- Hook style to try next: rotate to **contrast** (1.75x in learning loop) or **top3** (1.5x, n=5); avoid **question** (only 39% of comparison per reach on IG) and **comparison** (1.0x, low IG engagement).
- Topics to avoid: repeating "manual lead hunting exhaustion" or "hours on Google Maps" — three recent lead_gen posts already cover this pain point.
- Reminder: every post must read like a developer showing real work, never an ad; no demos, samples, guarantees, or niche/region targeting.

instructions.research: List 3 fresh angles for lead-gen that speak to freelancers/agencies/any service seller (not web devs) — e.g., "newly opened businesses have no vendor yet", "review count signals budget", "website check reveals tech maturity".
instructions.analysis: Compare the two published lead_gen posts: 10-23 (top3, "3 things that happen...") vs 10-27 (comparison, "Spray and Pray vs Surgical"). Note which hook style and angle type earned more DMs/profile visits.
instructions.writer: Write a lead_gen post using a **contrast** hook. Open with "Freelancers, agencies, anyone selling a service...". Describe LocalSignal sheet only in general terms: local businesses from Google Places with contact details, review counts, website checks, newly opened ones. End with "pay after approval" offer and invite DM for honest fit advice.
instructions.image: Create a clean silhouette-style graphic (silhouette 1.5x in learning loop): outline of India with scattered pins, one highlighted row of a spreadsheet showing business name, phone, reviews, website yes/no. No logos, no niche icons.
instructions.video: Not required for today's lead_gen post; focus on static image/carousel.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio: remove "hotels, cafes, gyms & homestays in Himachal", "ready in 24 hrs", and "Free 2-min site check". Replace with: "Websites, AI chatbots, animated ads & lead sheets for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for honest advice."
Leave 5 thoughtful comments on posts by Indian freelancers/agencies discussing client acquisition (not self-promo).
Share today's published post to 2-3 relevant LinkedIn groups or X/Twitter threads where service sellers ask for lead sources.
